messages:
Aisha (CS): Heads-up: MediSure Labs finished their pilot. They dumped a spreadsheet with ~10 items — mix of UX routing asks, data residency questions, and 2 model-behavior reports. Need a tight capture flow so nothing falls through before renewal.
Diego (Onboarding): I skimmed it. There are 2 legal/regulatory asks about data locality + audit logs — they flagged those as blockers for production.
Lena (AE): Renewal in 7 weeks. Anything marked blocker should get AE + CS visibility immediately.
Ravi (Product): Can we get the raw ask rows pasted here or a view link? we should avoid re-keying.
Aisha (CS): Uploaded redacted sheet: https://redwood.app/msp/medisure/pilot-asks (private). Summary: 3 routing tweaks, 2 data residency/audit, 1 per-route billing visibility, 2 hallucination-suspected cases, 2 minor UI polish.
ops-bot: New template available: /templates/cs-quick-capture-2026 v1.1
Aisha (CS): Draft capture form (1-pager):
```
- Customer: MediSure Labs
- Reporter: Onboarding (Diego)
- Short ask (one sentence)
- Why it matters / customer impact
- Severity: blocker / high / medium / low
- Affects renewal? Yes / No
- Expected frequency / affected routes (e.g., 5% of requests, post-auth route X)
- Example input + failing output (if model-behavior)
- Workaround
- Links / attachments
```
Ravi (Product): Add: "Regulatory flag" checkbox and "Data residency required" field. For model items include "repro steps" and model config used.
Lena (AE): Also add: "Procurement impact" (none / some / large) so we know if Legal/Procurement need to be looped.
Diego (Onboarding): I'll fill the 2 legal rows as blocker + data residency: EU-only.
Aisha (CS): Suggested process: Onboarding fills form -> CS triage assigns severity -> Product tags effort (S/M/L) and regulatory flag -> PMs pick into next intake.
Ravi (Product): Agree. I'll create a lightweight triage rubric: impact 1-5, effort S/M/L, regulatory: Y/N, renewal-risk: Y/N. Put rubric in the intake doc.
Aisha (CS): Can Product triage the 2 suspected hallucination reports this week? they include prompt + outputs. Could be model drift or prompt-engineering issue.
Ravi (Product): I'll review. Please attach the prompt and failed output in the form. If it's safety-related, tag as "safety review".
Lena (AE): Marking data residency asks as high and renewal-risk: yes. I'll start a renewal note for the account exec team.
Diego (Onboarding): Filled 4 rows now (3 routing, 1 data residency). Sending form links into #cs-triage. :rocket:
ops-bot: Capture saved -> /captures/1749998881-medisure-pilot-asks.json (access: team-only)
Aisha (CS): Next steps: Diego completes remaining items by EOD, Product reviews model-behavior items by Thu, AE updates renewal play.
Ravi (Product): I'll ack in #product-intake once reviewed. If any item is regulatory or blocker, we'll escalate to on-call PM.
Lena (AE): If procurement/proc impact = large, I'll request a Legal + Solutions meeting.
Aisha (CS): Thanks all. Template link and triage rubric will be added to the onboarding playbook. Ping me if you need direct access. :white_check_mark:
